fullPassage: Every day in each of my classes I randomly select two students who are given the title of "official questioners." These students are assigned the responsibility to ask at least one question during that class. After being the day's official questioner, one of my students, Carrie, visited me in my office. Just to break the ice, I asked in a lighthearted way, "Did you feel honored to be named one of the first 'official questioners' of the semester?" In a serious tone, she answered that she'd been extremely nervous when I appointed her at the beginning of class. But then, during that class, she felt differently from how she'd felt during other lectures. It was a lecture just like the others, but this time, she said, she was forced to have a higher level of consciousness she was more aware of the content of the lecture and discussion. She also admitted that as a result she got more out of that class.

② asking ❌ the responsibility asking → the responsibility to ask — 명사 뒤 to부정사가 형용사적 용법으로 '~할 책임'의 의미. 동명사 asking은 구조적으로 부적절 ←정답

③ visited ✅ Carrie visited me in my office — 과거시제 타동사, 시제·태 모두 적절

④ admitted ✅ She also admitted that — 과거시제 타동사, that절 목적어로 적절
det.tip: the responsibility to ask = ~할 책임 (to부정사 형용사적 용법)

det.korean: ③ she's → she'd been: answered(과거)보다 이전 시점이므로 과거완료가 필요한 자리에 현재시제는 시제 오류

④ how ✅ differently from how she'd felt — 간접의문문 접속사 how, '어떻게 느꼈는지'의 의미로 적절

det.korean: ④ forcing → forced: she was forced(수동태)가 올바른데 forcing(능동 분사)으로 바뀌면 수동/능동 오류
det.analysis:

② named ✅ to be named one of the first — 수동태 to부정사 과거분사, '~로 이름 붙여지다'의 의미로 적절

④ forcing ❌ she was forcing to have → she was forced to have — 주어 she가 '강요받는' 대상이므로 수동태(was forced) 필수. was forcing은 능동 진행형으로 '그녀가 강요하고 있었다'가 되어 의미 오류 ←정답
det.tip: be forced to V (수동: ~하도록 강요받다) vs. be forcing (능동 진행: ~를 강요하는 중)
